summary.description: Two or three sentences: what the change does and how sound it is.

kind.description: The bold title of the AGENTS.md "Mistakes that keep coming back" item this falls under, verbatim, or "other".

check.description: The lint rule, Semgrep rule, type check or test that would have caught it, if one would.

file.description: Path in the repository, if the finding is about one file.

line.description: Line in the pull request's version of the file.

detail.description: What is wrong, what happens because of it, and the fix.
